sentences.l2: 咖啡是很多人每天都会喝的饮料。
sentences.l1: Coffee is a drink that many people drink every day.

sentences.l2: 世界上很多国家都消费咖啡，但并不是每个国家都能种植咖啡豆。
sentences.l1: Many countries in the world consume coffee, but not every country can grow coffee beans.

sentences.l2: 咖啡豆的种植属于农业活动，主要在热带地区进行。
sentences.l1: The growing of coffee beans is an agricultural activity, carried out mainly in tropical regions.

sentences.l2: 一些国家如南美洲和非洲的部分国家，气候温暖湿润，适合咖啡树生长。
sentences.l1: Some countries, such as some countries in South America and Africa, have a warm and humid climate suitable for coffee trees to grow.

sentences.l2: 农民在那里种植咖啡树，收获咖啡果实，再把果实加工成咖啡豆。
sentences.l1: Farmers there plant coffee trees, harvest coffee fruit, and then process the fruit into coffee beans.

sentences.l2: 这些国家会把咖啡豆出口到其他国家。
sentences.l1: These countries export coffee beans to other countries.

sentences.l2: 出口意味着把商品卖到国外。
一些没有种植条件的国家，比如一些欧洲国家，需要从国外进口咖啡豆。
sentences.l1: Some countries without growing conditions, such as some European countries, need to import coffee beans from abroad.

sentences.l2: 进口就是从别的国家买进商品。
sentences.l1: Importing is buying goods from other countries.

sentences.l2: 通过国际贸易，咖啡豆从生产地运往世界各地。
sentences.l1: Through international trade, coffee beans are transported from the place of production to all parts of the world.

sentences.l2: 消费者可以在超市或咖啡馆购买咖啡产品。
sentences.l1: Consumers can buy coffee products in supermarkets or coffee shops.

sentences.l2: 全球咖啡豆供应链包括种植、加工、运输、销售等多个环节。
sentences.l1: The global coffee bean supply chain includes many links such as growing, processing, transportation, and sales.

sentences.l2: 虽然咖啡豆原产于非洲，但现在它已经成为全球贸易中的重要商品。
sentences.l1: Although coffee beans originated in Africa, they have now become an important commodity in global trade.

sentences.l2: 有些国家自己种咖啡，也喝咖啡；有些国家不种咖啡，但人们很喜欢喝，所以要靠进口满足消费需求。
sentences.l1: Some countries grow coffee themselves and also drink coffee; some countries do not grow coffee, but people like to drink it very much, so they have to rely on imports to meet consumption demand.

sentences.l2: 这个过程连接了不同国家的农民、公司和普通消费者。
sentences.l1: This process connects farmers, companies, and ordinary consumers in different countries.

sentences.l2: 虽然价格会受到天气、运输成本等因素影响，但人们还是愿意为一杯咖啡付出费用。
sentences.l1: Although prices are affected by factors such as weather and transportation costs, people are still willing to pay for a cup of coffee.

sentences.l2: 咖啡不仅是一种饮品，也反映了全球经济的联系。
sentences.l1: Coffee is not only a kind of drink, but also reflects the connections of the global economy.
